title: Deep learning with noisy labels: Exploring techniques and remedies in medical image analysis

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Deep learning with noisy labels: Exploring techniques and remedies in medical image analysis》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】To help achieve a better understanding of the extent of the problem and its potential remedies, we conducted experiments with three medical imaging datasets with different types of label noise, where we investigated several existing strategies and developed new methods to combat the negative effect of label noise.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Deep learning with noisy labels: Exploring techniques and remedies in medical image analysis》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Supervised training of deep learning models requires large labeled datasets.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】Based on the results of these experiments and our review of the literature, we have made recommendations on methods that can be used to alleviate the effects of different types of label noise on deep models trained for medical image analysis.
